items.information: # THIS COMPETITION HAS BEEN POSTPONED TO A LATER DATE DUE TO SEVERE WINTER WEATHER. THE COMPETITION IS NOW TAKING PLACE ON FRIDAY, FEBRUARY 20TH. ***Please check the schedule for when each event is being held. The less popular events are being held in the morning before lunch, while more popular events such as 3x3 and 2x2 will be after lunch.*** This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC.
